blocks.text: In the Arab information ecosystem, false, misleading or deleted content circulates daily alongside news: messages sent in family groups, old photos presented as new, invented quotes, sites that mimic real newspapers. There is also an Arab journalistic genre dedicated to verification ( ⁧تَدْقِيقُ المَعْلُومَاتِ⁩ ), with a vocabulary and its own structure. In this unit learn the types of misinformation and their Arabic names, language signals that make a content suspicious, verification steps as they are described by fact-checking platforms, and the vocabulary of the verification articles ( ⁧الاِدِّعَاء⁩ , ⁧التَّقْيِيم⁩ , ⁧مُضَلِّل⁩ , ⁧خَارِجَ سِيَاقِهِ⁩ ). The method is the public one of media education: no operational technique. Two weeks.
